name: fish_audio
description: Text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice design and voice cloning with Fish Audio
long_description: Bring a Fish Audio API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key reads the account's API credit balance (GET /wallet/self/api-credit), which costs nothing. A Sprite can then generate speech, transcribe recordings, design candidate voices, edit a span of a recording with drama-3, browse and read voice models, and create a private voice clone. Generation, transcription, voice design and infill are billed to your Fish Audio API credit, except text-to-speech with the free s2.1-pro-free model. Updating or deleting voice models, API key revocation, wallet packages, pronunciation dictionaries, the voice-agent platform and the WebSocket streaming endpoints are not forwarded.

examples.title: Generate speech with the free s2.1-pro-free model (no credit spent)
notes: The response body is the audio file; save it with `--output hello.mp3`.
Add `"reference_id": "MODEL_ID"` to speak with a voice model. Other models (`s2.1-pro`, `s2-pro`, `drama-3`) spend API credit; without a `model` header the request is served and billed as `s2.1-pro`.

examples.title: Design two candidate voices from a prompt (spends $0.01 of API credit)

json.instruction: Warm, confident studio narrator with a natural tone

notes: Each candidate carries its audio as `audio_base64`. Extra request fields are rejected.

examples.title: Read one voice model; replace MODEL_ID

messages.400: Fish Audio rejected the request (%{status}); read the body's message
messages.402: No Fish Audio API credit for this model; use s2.1-pro-free or add credit at fish.audio/app/developers/billing
messages.403: Fish Audio does not allow this key to use that resource
messages.404: Fish Audio did not find that model or voice; for /v1/audio/infill, send the header model: drama-3
messages.413: Request too large for Fish Audio; send compressed audio such as MP3 or Opus
messages.429: Fish Audio concurrency limit reached; retry with backoff
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Fish Audio; retry later

presentation.tagline: Generate speech, transcribe audio and clone voices with Fish Audio from a Sprite without putting your API key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at fish.audio, open Developers → Get Started (fish.audio/app/developers/get-started) and click Get your API key. The key is shown only once. New accounts have no API credit; text-to-speech with the `s2.1-pro-free` model is free.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /wallet/self/api-credit` and costs nothing. Text-to-speech is billed per million UTF-8 bytes of input text: `s2.1-pro` and `s2-pro` $15, `drama-3` $50 ($10 until 2026-11-30), `s2.1-pro-free` $0. Speech-to-text (`POST /v1/asr`) is $0.36 per audio hour, rounded up to the second, including silence. Voice design is $0.01 per successful request. Audio infill uses `drama-3`. Creating a voice model and reading models and the balance are not listed as billed. Requests that return an error are not billed.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `POST /v1/tts`, `POST /v1/asr`, `POST /v1/voice-design`, `POST /v1/audio/infill`, `GET`/`POST /model`, `GET /model/:id` and `GET /wallet/self/api-credit` are forwarded, with the `model` request header (it selects the TTS, transcription, voice-design or infill model). Updating and deleting voice models, API key revocation, wallet packages, pronunciation dictionaries, the voice-agent platform (`/v1/agent/...`) and the WebSocket endpoints are not.

notices.title: Timeouts and limits
notices.body: Sprites waits 120 seconds for a response to start, and Fish Audio has no timeout parameter. Transcription answers only when the whole file is done, so long `transcribe-1-pro` recordings can take longer than that; keep recordings to a few minutes through the gateway. Requests share your account's concurrency limit (5 at once below $100 paid); at the limit Fish Audio answers 429 without `Retry-After`.

usage_notes.title: Transcribe a recording
usage_notes.body: Set `FISH_GATEWAY_URL` to the connection's gateway URL, replace `clip.mp3` with your file path, and run `curl -H 'model: transcribe-1-pro' -F audio=@clip.mp3 -F ignore_timestamps=false "${FISH_GATEWAY_URL%/}/v1/asr"`. Without the exact header `model: transcribe-1-pro` the request is served and billed as `transcribe-1`. The Sprites gateway accepts request bodies of at most 8,000,000 bytes, so send compressed audio.

usage_notes.title: Create a private voice clone
usage_notes.body: Run `curl -F type=tts -F train_mode=fast -F title='My voice' -F visibility=private -F voices=@sample.wav -F texts='Transcript of the sample.' "${FISH_GATEWAY_URL%/}/model"`, then pass the returned `_id` as `reference_id` to `POST /v1/tts`. Public requests are downgraded to private.

usage_notes.title: Edit a span of a recording
usage_notes.body: `POST /v1/audio/infill` needs the header `model: drama-3` (without it Fish Audio answers 404) and a multipart body: `curl -H 'model: drama-3' -F audio=@take.mp3 --form-string 'transcript=Full revised text.' -F prefix_seconds=2.1 -F suffix_seconds=3.4 "${FISH_GATEWAY_URL%/}/v1/audio/infill" --output edited.mp3`.
